item.title: Enlivex: $212 Million Private Placement Announced And Former Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi Appointed To Board Of Directors
item.description: Enlivex Therapeutics had unveiled significant financing and a prominent board appointment as the company initiates a new digital asset treasury strategy centered on RAIN prediction markets. The clinical-stage immunotherapy company announced a $212 million private placement alongside the appointment of former Italian Prime Minister Matteo Renzi to its board of directors.

item.title: Okami Medical: $45 Million In New Funding Raised And New CEO Appointed
item.description: Okami Medical has closed an oversubscribed $45 million financing round led by new investor Gilde Healthcare, with participation from existing backers Vensana Capital and U.S. Venture Partners. The company plans to deploy the capital to expand its commercial reach and further advance its clinical programs, aligned with its mission to improve treatment outcomes for patients with vascular disease. item.title: Rencore: Series A Extended To $15 Million As It Expands AI Governance Platform And International Footprint
item.description: Rencore has expanded its Series A funding round to $15 million, providing the Munich-based software company with additional capital to advance its AI and Agent Governance platform and accelerate global expansion. The extension round was led by European technology investor Hi Inov, with continued participation from existing backers UVC Partners and Capnamic Ventures.

item.title: EPA Announces $3 Billion In Funding To Accelerate Lead Pipe Removal
item.description: The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency announced a significant nationwide effort to eliminate lead service lines, allocating $3 billion in new funding to states through the State Revolving Fund programs. The agency also confirmed the redistribution of $1.1 billion in previously awarded but unused federal dollars to ensure communities with the most urgent needs receive timely assistance.

item.title: Enhanced Announces $1.2 Billion Public Listing Plan Through Business Combination With A Paradise Acquisition Corp.
item.description: Enhanced Ltd has agreed to merge with A Paradise Acquisition Corp., paving the way for the elite sports and performance company to go public at an enterprise value of $1.2 billion. The combined entity, to be renamed Enhanced Group Inc., is expected to list on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol ENHA pending regulatory approval and shareholder consent. The transaction is expected to deliver up to $200 million in gross cash proceeds, assuming no redemptions by A Paradise shareholders

item.title: IQM: Over €40 Million Investment Announced To Expand Finland Production Facility
item.description: IQM Quantum Computers announced plans to significantly expand its state-of-the-art production facility in Espoo, Finland, with an investment of more than €40 million. The initiative will enhance the company’s capacity to produce advanced quantum chips and full-stack quantum computer systems while accelerating progress toward large-scale, error-corrected quantum computing.

item.title: FundedFirm Reaches $15 Million In Trader Payouts As Global Demand For Funded Accounts Accelerates
item.description: FundedFirm announced it has surpassed $15 million in total trader payouts, marking a significant milestone for the international funded-trader ecosystem. The company’s achievement reflects growing interest in structured trading capital programs as traders seek accessible, reliable alternatives to traditional funding models.
